commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'os-release: '; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'kernel: '; uname -r
printf 'boot-id: '; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'worker: '; stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
printf 'worker-type: '; file /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
printf 'account: '; if getent passwd inventorysvc; then :; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf 'service-enabled: '; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service 2>&1 || true
printf 'service-active: '; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service 2>&1 || true
printf 'selinux: '; getenforce 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Comparison Worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
restorecon -v /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service /var/lib/inventory-worker 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

set -eu
printf 'boot-id: '; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id

printf 'enabled: '; systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
printf 'active: '; systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
printf 'main-pid: %s\n' "$pid"
printf 'process: '; ps -o user=,group=,pid=,ppid=,stat=,args= -p "$pid"
printf 'unit-user: '; systemctl show -p User --value inventory-worker.service
printf 'unit-exec: '; systemctl show -p ExecStart --value inventory-worker.service
printf 'account: '; getent passwd inventorysvc
printf 'failed-units: '; systemctl --failed --no-legend | wc -l
